FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Silk Blooms Floral Supplies specializes in the retail and wholesale of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations focus on providing a diverse range of products for various customer needs, including home decor, events, and seasonal displays. We maintain a climate-controlled and secured inventory space to ensure the quality of our products, particularly those sensitive to temperature fluctuations. Our team is trained in basic floral design principles and customer service, enhancing the overall shopping experience for our clients. We operate a brick-and-mortar store, with online sales constituting less than 50% of our revenue, thereby keeping our core operations grounded in physical retail. Our commitment to safety is reflected in the ongoing training all staff undergo, promoting a secure and efficient working environment. Compliance with local regulations, including zoning and fire codes, is rigorously maintained to ensure smooth and lawful operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in online sales that exceed 50% of total revenue and confirms that we do not conduct any high-risk event installations or complex rigging activities. Additionally, all storage areas for bulk inventory are secured and climate-controlled, and we have established fire protection systems, including sprinklers and smoke detectors, that are regularly maintained.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred between March 10, 2021, and April 5, 2021, due to unexpected water damage from a burst pipe in the inventory storage area. Total amount lost was $3,500, and the claim has been resolved with the payout received.
